claim: With ElastiCache Serverless you pay for data stored in GB-hours and for compute in ElastiCache Processing Units (ECPU). With a node-based cluster you pay per hour of cache node usage.
question: What are the pricing dimensions of ElastiCache Serverless and of node-based clusters?

values.display: data stored in GB-hours and compute in ElastiCache Processing Units (ECPU)
values.spoken: gigabyte-hours of data and ECPUs of compute

values.display: per hour of the cache node usage
values.spoken: per hour for each cache node

evidence.quote: When deploying ElastiCache Serverless, you pay for usage for data stored in GB-hours and compute in ElastiCache Processing Units (ECPU). When creating a node-based cluster, you pay per hour of the cache node usage.

claim: Simple reads and writes require 1 ECPU for each kilobyte (KB) of data transferred. A GET that transfers up to 1 KB consumes 1 ECPU, and a SET that transfers 3.2 KB consumes 3.2 ECPUs.
question: How many ECPUs does a simple read or write consume?

values.display: 3.2 KB of data will consume 3.2 ECPUs
values.spoken: three point two ECPUs for three point two kilobytes

qualifiers.scope: per simple read or write on ElastiCache Serverless

evidence.quote: Simple reads and writes require 1 ECPU for each kilobyte (KB) of data transferred. For example, a GET command that transfers up to 1 KB of data consumes 1 ECPU. A SET request that transfers 3.2 KB of data will consume 3.2 ECPUs.

claim: With Valkey and Redis OSS, commands that consume more vCPU time and transfer more data consume ECPUs based on the higher of the two dimensions. For example, an HMGET that uses 3 times the vCPU time of a simple SET/GET and transfers 3.2 KB consumes 3.2 ECPU, and if it transfers only 2 KB it consumes 3 ECPUs.
question: How are ECPUs counted for Valkey and Redis OSS commands that use more vCPU time than a simple GET or SET?

values.display: based on the higher of the two dimensions
values.spoken: the higher of vCPU time and data transferred

qualifiers.scope: per command on ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey or Redis OSS
qualifiers.condition: commands that use more vCPU time and transfer more data

evidence.quote: With Valkey and Redis OSS, commands that consume more vCPU time and transfer more data consume ECPUs based on the higher of the two dimensions. For example, if your application uses the HMGET command, consumes 3 times the vCPU time as a simple SET/GET command, and transfers 3.2 KB of data, it will consume 3.2 ECPU. Alternatively, if it transfers only 2 KB of data, it will consume 3 ECPUs.

claim: With Memcached, commands that operate on multiple items consume proportionally more ECPUs. For example, a multiget on 3 items consumes 3 ECPUs.
question: How many ECPUs does a Memcached multiget on several items consume?

values.display: a multiget on 3 items, it will consume 3 ECPUs
values.spoken: a multiget on three items consumes three ECPUs

qualifiers.scope: per Memcached command on ElastiCache Serverless
qualifiers.condition: commands that operate on multiple items

evidence.quote: With Memcached, commands that operate on multiple items will consume proportionally more ECPUs. For example, if your application performs a multiget on 3 items, it will consume 3 ECPUs.

claim: ElastiCache Serverless continuously monitors the amount of data stored in your cache, sampling multiple times per minute, and calculates an hourly average to determine the cache's data storage usage in GB-hrs.
question: How does ElastiCache Serverless meter data storage for billing?

evidence.quote: ElastiCache Serverless continuously monitors the amount of data stored in your cache, sampling multiple times per minute, and calculates an hourly average to determine the cache’s data storage usage in GB-hrs.

claim: The minimum metered data storage is 100 MB per cache for ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey and 1 GB per cache for ElastiCache for Memcached and ElastiCache for Redis OSS.
question: What is the minimum metered data storage per ElastiCache Serverless cache for each engine?

qualifiers.condition: 100 MB for Valkey; 1 GB for Memcached and Redis OSS

evidence.quote: Minimum metered data storage: 100 MB per cache for ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey and 1 GB per cache for ElastiCache for Memcached and ElastiCache for Redis OSS.

note: The guide page WhatIs.corecomponents says each serverless cache is metered for a minimum of 1 GB without naming an engine; the pricing page and the FAQ give 100 MB for Valkey. The pricing page is used here.
